diag.docker.ok: Docker is reachable through the socket.
diag.docker.fix: Mount the Docker socket in the TransBack container: /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
diag.nc.notFound: No running Nextcloud container was found.
diag.nc.forcedMissing: The container "{name}" (NEXTCLOUD_CONTAINER) was not found or has no occ.
diag.nc.fix: Start Nextcloud, or set NEXTCLOUD_CONTAINER to the name of your Nextcloud container.
diag.nc.multiple: Several Nextcloud servers were found ({list}): TransBack uses "{name}".
diag.nc.multipleFix: Set NEXTCLOUD_CONTAINER to the name of the container to use.
diag.nc.occFix: Check that Nextcloud is installed and running (occ status inside the container).
diag.owner.ok: Files will belong to the Nextcloud web user ({uid}:{gid}).
diag.data.ok: Nextcloud data folder available in TransBack: {path} (host: {host}).
diag.data.notMounted: The Nextcloud data folder ({host} on the host) is not mounted in TransBack.
diag.data.fix: Add this volume to the TransBack container: {host}:{host}
diag.data.noHost: The Nextcloud data folder ({path}) is not a Docker mount, it cannot be shared.
diag.data.noHostFix: Store the Nextcloud data folder on a bind mount or named volume, then mount it in TransBack.
diag.data.inspectFix: Check that TransBack can use the Docker socket.
diag.gf.missing: Group folders app not enabled: only users' personal folders can be used as destinations.
diag.fs.ok: All disk formats are supported (APFS, HFS+, HFS, exFAT, NTFS…).
diag.fs.fix: Mount the host kernel modules in TransBack: /lib/modules:/lib/modules:ro (on Ugreen NAS: /usr/lib/modules:/lib/modules:ro).
diag.auth.off: No authentication: anyone who can reach TransBack can use it.
diag.auth.fix: Set TB_PASSWORD, or TB_TRUST_PROXY_AUTH behind an authenticating proxy (Cloudflare Access, Authelia…).
disk.hostMountDead: Mounted by the host but unreadable
disk.hostMountGone: No longer mounted by the host
disk.notFound: Disk not found: it may have been unplugged.
eject.incomplete: Eject incomplete, a file may still be open. {details}
eject.busyQueued: Cannot eject: a transfer using this disk is waiting in the queue. Remove it from the queue first.
eject.busyPaused: Cannot eject: a transfer using this disk is paused. Resume or cancel it first.
eject.busyRunning: Cannot eject: a transfer using this disk is running. Wait for it to finish or cancel it.
err.duplicateNames: Two selected folders are named "{name}": they would be merged in Nextcloud. Transfer them separately, with a different parent folder.
err.parentInvalid: Invalid parent folder (no "/", "\", and it cannot start with a dot).
err.subPathInvalid: Invalid subfolder (no "..", "\", and no part starting with a dot).
err.targetUnknown: This destination no longer exists in Nextcloud.
err.targetMissingOnDisk: The destination folder does not exist on disk: {path}
err.bwlimitInvalid: Invalid bandwidth limit (whole number of KB/s, 0 = unlimited).
err.webhookInvalid: The webhook must be an http(s) URL.
err.ncUnavailable: Nextcloud is not available: open Settings › Diagnostics.
err.dataUnavailable: The Nextcloud data folder is not available in TransBack: open Settings › Diagnostics.
err.removeRunning: A running task cannot be removed.
err.legacySource: This task was created by an older version of TransBack: create it again.
task.noSpace: Not enough space: {needed} to copy, only {free} free.
task.partial23: ⚠️  Partial transfer (rsync 23): some files could not be read or copied (see ⚠️ above).
task.partial24: ⚠️  Partial transfer (rsync 24): some files disappeared from the source during the copy.
task.watchdogLog: 🛑 rsync has been unresponsive for {minutes} min (disk unplugged or stuck?): forced stop.
task.forksSearch: Looking for old Mac files with a resource fork…
task.forksFound: 🍎 {count} old Mac file(s) keep their content in the resource fork: copied empty.
task.forksSummary: 🍎 Mac files to check ({count}): all their content is in the resource fork, which Nextcloud does not keep. They are empty in Nextcloud; keep the original disk for these.
task.doneOk: 🎉 Finished — the data is available in Nextcloud!
task.interruptedByRestart: ⚠️ Transfer interrupted by a server restart. Click Resume to continue.
post.indexTargetedFailed: ℹ️ Targeted indexing not possible for {path}: {error}
diag.nc.notFoundOptional: No Nextcloud container found: only the folder destinations can be used.
diag.folders.ok: {count} folder destination(s) in {root}: {list} (copy only, no Nextcloud indexing).
diag.folders.none: No Nextcloud and no folder destination: there is nowhere to copy to.
diag.folders.fix: Mount a Nextcloud data folder, or mount one or more folders under {root} (e.g. /srv/archives:{root}/Archives).
